# Ranktracker

> > Ranktracker is an all-in-one SEO platform combining rank tracking, keyword research, SERP analysis, website audits, and backlink monitoring with AI-powered content generation.

Ranktracker provides comprehensive SEO tools for keyword research, rank tracking across multiple search engines (Google, Bing, Yahoo, Yandex), competitor analysis, and technical website optimization. The platform serves entrepreneurs, businesses, and agencies with flexible pricing plans and includes free tools for SEO optimization.

## Key Topics

- Rank Tracking
- Keyword Research
- SERP Analysis
- Backlink Monitoring
- Website Audit
- Competitor Analysis
- SEO Tools
- Domain Authority

- Link Building

## Core SEO Tools

- [Ranktracker: The all-in-one platform for effective SEO](https://www.ranktracker.com): All-in-one SEO platform for keyword research, rank tracking, SERP analysis and website audits.
- [Rank Tracker - Website rank tracking tool](https://www.ranktracker.com/rank-tracker): Daily/weekly/monthly website ranking updates across search engines with comprehensive tracking.
- [Keyword Finder - Keyword research and analysis](https://www.ranktracker.com/keyword-finder): SEO keyword research with difficulty scoring and location-based targeting for campaign planning.
- [SERP Checker - Google SERP competitor analysis](https://www.ranktracker.com/serp-checker): Analyze Google search results and competitor research across desktop and mobile platforms.
- [Website Audit - SEO health check tool](https://www.ranktracker.com/web-audit): Fast SEO health checks scanning 100+ data points for comprehensive optimization insights.

## Backlink & Authority Tools

- [Backlink Checker - See every backlink](https://www.ranktracker.com/backlink-checker): Analyze competitor backlinks and domain/URL authority metrics for link building strategy.
- [Backlink Monitor - Track your backlinks](https://www.ranktracker.com/backlink-monitor): Track backlinks with anchor text analysis and continuous link monitoring capabilities.
- [White Label SaaS Backlink Service](https://www.ranktracker.com/white-label-saas-backlink-service): White label backlink service for reselling high-authority backlinks to clients.

## Content & Optimization Tools

- [AI Article Writer - powered by GPT-4](https://www.ranktracker.com/ai-article-writer): AI-powered content creation using GPT-4 for SEO-optimized articles with keyword targeting.
- [SERP Simulator - Free SERP Snippet Preview](https://www.ranktracker.com/serp-simulator): Free tool for previewing search result snippets with title and meta description optimization.
- [SEO Checklist - Website SEO setup tool](https://www.ranktracker.com/seo-tasks): Interactive guide covering on-page and off-page SEO optimization for complete website setup.
- [Free SEO Tools](https://www.ranktracker.com/free-seo-tools): Collection of free SEO tools including YouTube, TikTok and AI writing tools for optimization.
